review_comments.body: **Overrides add an extra slash** Overrides ending in `/` produce `//v2/completion`. If the server distinguishes those paths, requests may fail. Strip trailing slashes before appending `/v2/completion`

**Ignored deployments look identical** `Others ignored` lists only configuration names. If deployments share a configuration, developers cannot distinguish them. Include ignored deployment URLs or IDs alongside names Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Tests miss required annotations** New helpers lack types and locals lack `Final`. `AGENTS.md` requires fully typed new code and `Final` variables. Add these annotations before merging **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/berriai/litellm/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
Thanks, applied in c8f5d0e: the new test helpers and locals are typed with `Final` and read-only `Mapping`/`tuple`, and the type discipline check is clean
